why: DOCS ONLY, ONE FILE: the WO object. It records the observation this WO has been waiting on since #11519 merged — the sweeper's FIRST SCHEDULED RUN, and the first time the whole path ran with no session in it. Run 34518595813, run_number 1, event=schedule, 2026-09-10T19:08:22Z. GRADED BY THE FOUR RULES THE PREVIOUS SECTION FIXED IN ADVANCE, so it cannot be read as a loose pass: (1) event is `schedule`, not a hand-fired workflow_dispatch; (2) the SWEEP JOB'S OWN conclusion is success and all six steps executed with real durations, none SKIPPED — the trap this WO records (work-digest run 34383191261 concluded success with its job skipped behind a gate) checked rather than assumed; (3) exit code 0, read off the verdict step's own `case "0"` branch, so this is not the exit-2 COULD NOT LOOK path mistaken for an empty queue; (4) the refresh verified as EFFECT. WHAT IT SAW — POPULATION: 47 open PRs read from the API, 44 with an automation/* head ref: refresh 1, superseded_older 24, carries_append_only 6, absent_on_main 2, undated_payload 11 (sums to 44). It refused 19 out loud as needing a human read and touched none of them. `absent_on_main`, the eighth state added the day before, fired on two live PRs. ⚠️ AND IT LANDED THE ONE ACTIONABLE STRAND: #11710 (automation/session-reaper-34501786024-1) was refreshed and pushed at 19:08:59Z and MERGED AT 19:11:26Z, 2m27s later, on green, with no human act. VERIFIED AS EFFECT, four ways, none of them the sweeper's report: the head commit 8038c342 is authored by github-actions[bot] at 19:08:59Z; merge_slot at that head names `stale-automation-sweep run 34518595813` — the same run id — and that branch; main's tip at sweep time (df0116b7) IS an ancestor of the refreshed head, so the strand is gone rather than reported gone; and it merged, so the required checks re-ran on the new sha and passed. THIS IS THE HALF SEVEN HAND-RUNS COULD NOT PROVE — CI's clean checkout, a different token, unattended, on a branch no session had touched. Also recorded: the first-run lag (registered 15:09:12Z, first run 19:08:22Z = 3h59m; it fired BEFORE the 19:17Z slot and a cron cannot fire early, so it is the 17:17Z slot 1h51m late, and two declared slots produced one run) as a datum for BL-20260830. ⚠️ WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: one run is not a cadence — this workflow's own history is n=1, so the '~1 sweep per 6h window' figure still rests on purge-artifacts' plateau. The object stays in_flight deliberately: 24 superseded_older and 11 undated_payload PRs are open with recorded reasons and no disposition, which is a human act by this object's own argument, and closing on the strength of a good run is the tick-the-box move the work order forbids. Touches no src/, config/, deploy/ or order path.
